name: e2fsprogs
description: Set of utilities for creating, checking, resizing, and maintaining ext2/ext3/ext4 filesystems, including mkfs.ext4, e2fsck, resize2fs, and libext2fs.
install: cd e2fsprogs-1.47.1 && make DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" install install-libs
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
